description:
The command reference, command grammar, content standards reference, MCP server readme and changelog describe the surviving profile surface: show, diff, apply, pack and add.

## Background

The ownership lifecycle is gone (`@/charter/D-8`): the list, validate, reconfigure, upgrade and capture subcommands, the show command's applied field and target hashes, and conflict remedies. A selector is a bare package directory path; the `id:` and `path:` tags are gone. Plan and apply now report through one result type, and a package origin is a directory path.

Pages describing the removed surface (line numbers at the investigation baseline):

- `docs/reference/cli-commands.md`: init `id:` 546-555, the profile preamble 631-648, list/show/validate 656-737, diff claims and remedy 751-766, apply `id:` 791-830, reconfigure/upgrade/capture 832-967, pack and add references to capture at 977, 1041 and 1044, validate provenance at 3463 and 3526.
- `docs/reference/cli-command-grammar.md:86-89` and `docs/reference/jit-content-standards.md:12-13`.
- `mcp-server/README.md:91-94`.
- `CHANGELOG.md` [Unreleased] entries that describe the removed machinery (11-12, 114-150, 248-252, 291, 317-341, 354, 429-436, 653-663).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The command reference describes show, diff, apply, pack and add only, with bare-path selectors and plan and apply output described as one result.
- [hard] REQ-02: The command grammar and content standards references name no removed subcommand and no selector tag.
- [hard] REQ-03: The MCP server readme lists no removed tool.
- [hard] REQ-04: The changelog's unreleased section records the removal of the ownership lifecycle and its subcommands, and no unreleased entry still describes them as shipped.
title: Rewrite the profile command reference
